use super::parallel_execution::{AgentResult, AgentType};
use anyhow::Result;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::f64::EPSILON;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

const DEFAULT_HISTORY: usize = 512;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentQualitySample {
    pub agent: AgentType,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,
    pub success: bool,
    pub quality_score: f64,
    pub defect_probability: f64,
    pub anomaly: bool,
    pub note: Option<String>,
}

impl AgentQualitySample {
    pub fn from_result(result: &AgentResult) -> Self {
        let elapsed = result.elapsed_seconds.max(EPSILON);
        let base_quality = if result.success { 1.0 } else { 0.35 };
        let latency_penalty = (elapsed / 60.0).min(1.0);
        let defect_probability = if result.success { 0.05 * latency_penalty } else { 0.75 };
        let quality_score = (base_quality - latency_penalty).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

        Self {
            agent: result.agent,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            elapsed_seconds: elapsed,
            success: result.success,
            quality_score,
            defect_probability,
            anomaly: latency_penalty > 0.6 || defect_probability > 0.5,
            note: result
                .error
                .as_ref()
                .map(|err| err.chars().take(120).collect()),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GaussianEstimate {
    pub mean: f64,
    pub variance: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ControlLimits {
    pub mean: f64,
    pub upper_control_limit: f64,
    pub lower_control_limit: f64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AnovaSummary {
    pub between_group_variance: f64,
    pub within_group_variance: f64,
    pub f_statistic: f64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct QuantumAnnealingSummary {
    pub candidate_agent: Option<AgentType>,
    pub energy: f64,
    pub iteration: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct QualitySnapshot {
    pub gaussian_estimates: HashMap<AgentType, GaussianEstimate>,
    pub control_limits: ControlLimits,
    pub anova: Option<AnovaSummary>,
    pub quantum: QuantumAnnealingSummary,
    pub success_rate: f64,
    pub mean_latency: f64,
    pub defect_rate: f64,
    pub total_samples: usize,
    pub recent_samples: Vec<AgentQualitySample>,
}

impl QualitySnapshot {
    fn from_samples(samples: &[AgentQualitySample]) -> Self {
        let gaussian_estimates = compute_gaussian(samples);
        let control_limits = compute_control_limits(samples);
        let anova = compute_anova(samples);
        let quantum = compute_quantum(samples);

        let total_samples = samples.len();
        let success_rate = if total_samples == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            samples.iter().filter(|s| s.success).count() as f64 / total_samples as f64
        };

        let mean_latency = if total_samples == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            samples.iter().map(|s| s.elapsed_seconds).sum::<f64>() / total_samples as f64
        };

        let defect_rate = if total_samples == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            samples
                .iter()
                .map(|s| s.defect_probability)
                .sum::<f64>()
                / total_samples as f64
        };

        let recent_samples = samples
            .iter()
            .rev()
            .take(50)
            .cloned()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .into_iter()
            .rev()
            .collect();

        Self {
            gaussian_estimates,
            control_limits,
            anova,
            quantum,
            success_rate,
            mean_latency,
            defect_rate,
            total_samples,
            recent_samples,
        }
    }
}

pub struct QualityEngine {
    samples: RwLock<Vec<AgentQualitySample>>,
    max_history: usize,
}

impl Default for QualityEngine {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(DEFAULT_HISTORY)
    }
}

impl QualityEngine {
    pub fn new(max_history: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            samples: RwLock::new(Vec::with_capacity(max_history)),
            max_history: max_history.max(32),
        }
    }

    pub async fn record_result(&self, result: &AgentResult) -> Result<()> {
        let sample = AgentQualitySample::from_result(result);
        let mut guard = self.samples.write().await;
        guard.push(sample);
        if guard.len() > self.max_history {
            let overflow = guard.len() - self.max_history;
            guard.drain(0..overflow);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn snapshot(&self) -> QualitySnapshot {
        let guard = self.samples.read().await;
        QualitySnapshot::from_samples(&guard)
    }

    pub async fn drain(&self) -> Vec<AgentQualitySample> {
        let mut guard = self.samples.write().await;
        guard.drain(..).collect()
    }
}

fn compute_gaussian(samples: &[AgentQualitySample]) -> HashMap<AgentType, GaussianEstimate> {
    let mut grouped: HashMap<AgentType, Vec<f64>> = HashMap::new();
    for sample in samples {
        grouped
            .entry(sample.agent)
            .or_default()
            .push(sample.quality_score);
    }

    grouped
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(agent, quality_scores)| {
            let mean = mean(&quality_scores);
            let variance = variance(&quality_scores, mean);
            let std_dev = variance.sqrt();
            (
                agent,
                GaussianEstimate {
                    mean,
                    variance,
                    std_dev,
                },
            )
        })
        .collect()
}

fn compute_control_limits(samples: &[AgentQualitySample]) -> ControlLimits {
    if samples.is_empty() {
        return ControlLimits {
            mean: 0.0,
            upper_control_limit: 0.0,
            lower_control_limit: 0.0,
        };
    }

    let scores: Vec<f64> = samples.iter().map(|s| s.quality_score).collect();
    let mean = mean(&scores);
    let std_dev = variance(&scores, mean).sqrt();
    let sigma = 3.0 * std_dev;

    ControlLimits {
        mean,
        upper_control_limit: (mean + sigma).min(1.0),
        lower_control_limit: (mean - sigma).max(0.0),
    }
}

fn compute_anova(samples: &[AgentQualitySample]) -> Option<AnovaSummary> {
    if samples.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    let mut grouped: HashMap<AgentType, Vec<f64>> = HashMap::new();
    for sample in samples {
        grouped
            .entry(sample.agent)
            .or_default()
            .push(sample.quality_score);
    }

    if grouped.len() < 2 {
        return None;
    }

    let overall_values: Vec<f64> = samples.iter().map(|s| s.quality_score).collect();
    let overall_mean = mean(&overall_values);
    let mut between = 0.0;
    let mut within = 0.0;
    let mut dof_between = 0.0;
    let mut dof_within = 0.0;

    for values in grouped.values() {
        let group_mean = mean(values);
        let count = values.len() as f64;
        between += count * (group_mean - overall_mean).powi(2);
        dof_between += 1.0;

        for value in values {
            within += (value - group_mean).powi(2);
            dof_within += 1.0;
        }
    }

    if dof_between <= 1.0 || dof_within <= grouped.len() as f64 {
        return None;
    }

    let ms_between = between / (dof_between - 1.0);
    let ms_within = within / (dof_within - grouped.len() as f64);
    let f_statistic = if ms_within.abs() < EPSILON {
        0.0
    } else {
        ms_between / ms_within
    };

    Some(AnovaSummary {
        between_group_variance: ms_between,
        within_group_variance: ms_within,
        f_statistic,
    })
}

fn compute_quantum(samples: &[AgentQualitySample]) -> QuantumAnnealingSummary {
    if samples.is_empty() {
        return QuantumAnnealingSummary {
            candidate_agent: None,
            energy: 0.0,
            iteration: 0,
        };
    }

    let mut best_energy = f64::MAX;
    let mut candidate = None;
    let mut iteration = 0;

    for sample in samples.iter().rev().take(64) {
        iteration += 1;
        let latency_term = sample.elapsed_seconds / 10.0;
        let defect_term = sample.defect_probability * 2.0;
        let energy = latency_term + defect_term - sample.quality_score * 1.5;
        if energy < best_energy {
            best_energy = energy;
            candidate = Some(sample.agent);
        }
    }

    QuantumAnnealingSummary {
        candidate_agent: candidate,
        energy: best_energy,
        iteration,
    }
}

fn mean(values: &[f64]) -> f64 {
    if values.is_empty() {
        0.0
    } else {
        values.iter().sum::<f64>() / values.len() as f64
    }
}

fn variance(values: &[f64], mean: f64) -> f64 {
    if values.len() <= 1 {
        return 0.0;
    }
    values
        .iter()
        .map(|value| (value - mean).powi(2))
        .sum::<f64>()
        / (values.len() as f64 - 1.0)
}

use super::parallel_execution::{AgentResult, AgentType};
use anyhow::Result;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentQualitySample {
    pub agent: AgentType,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,
    pub success: bool,
    pub quality_score: f64,
    pub defect_probability: f64,
    pub anomaly: bool,
    pub note: Option<String>,
}

impl AgentQualitySample {
    pub fn from_result(result: &AgentResult) -> Self {
        let elapsed = result.elapsed_seconds.max(EPSILON);
        let base_quality = if result.success { 1.0 } else { 0.35 };
        let latency_penalty = (elapsed / 60.0).min(1.0);
        let defect_probability = if result.success { 0.05 * latency_penalty } else { 0.75 };
        let quality_score = (base_quality - latency_penalty).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

        Self {
            agent: result.agent,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            elapsed_seconds: elapsed,
            success: result.success,
            quality_score,
            defect_probability,
            anomaly: latency_penalty > 0.6 || defect_probability > 0.5,
            note: result
                .error
                .as_ref()
                .map(|err| err.chars().take(120).collect()),
        }
    }
}

&gt;&gt; fn compute_gaussian(samples: &amp;[AgentQualitySample]) -&gt; HashMap&lt;AgentType, GaussianEstimate&gt; {                                                                
&gt;&gt;     let mut grouped: HashMap&lt;AgentType, Vec&lt;f64&gt;&gt; = HashMap::new();
&gt;&gt;     for sample in samples {
&gt;&gt;         grouped
&gt;&gt;             .entry(sample.agent)
&gt;&gt;             .or_default()
&gt;&gt;             .push(sample.quality_score);
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     grouped
&gt;&gt;         .into_iter()
&gt;&gt;         .map(|(agent, quality_scores)| {
&gt;&gt;             let mean = mean(&amp;quality_scores);
&gt;&gt;             let variance = variance(&amp;quality_scores, mean);
&gt;&gt;             let std_dev = variance.sqrt();
&gt;&gt;             (
&gt;&gt;                 agent,
&gt;&gt;                 GaussianEstimate {
&gt;&gt;                     mean,
&gt;&gt;                     variance,
&gt;&gt;                     std_dev,
&gt;&gt;                 },
&gt;&gt;             )
&gt;&gt;         })
&gt;&gt;         .collect()
&gt;&gt; }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt; fn compute_control_limits(samples: &amp;[AgentQualitySample]) -&gt; ControlLimits { 
&gt;&gt;     if samples.is_empty() {
&gt;&gt;         return ControlLimits {
&gt;&gt;             mean: 0.0,
&gt;&gt;             upper_control_limit: 0.0,
&gt;&gt;             lower_control_limit: 0.0,
&gt;&gt;         };
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     let scores: Vec&lt;f64&gt; = samples.iter().map(|s| s.quality_score).collect();
&gt;&gt;     let mean = mean(&amp;scores);
&gt;&gt;     let std_dev = variance(&amp;scores, mean).sqrt();
&gt;&gt;     let sigma = 3.0 * std_dev;
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     ControlLimits {
&gt;&gt;         mean,
&gt;&gt;         upper_control_limit: (mean + sigma).min(1.0),
&gt;&gt;         lower_control_limit: (mean - sigma).max(0.0),
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt; }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt; fn compute_anova(samples: &amp;[AgentQualitySample]) -&gt; Option&lt;AnovaSummary&gt; {   
&gt;&gt;     if samples.is_empty() {
&gt;&gt;         return None;
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     let mut grouped: HashMap&lt;AgentType, Vec&lt;f64&gt;&gt; = HashMap::new();
&gt;&gt;     for sample in samples {
&gt;&gt;         grouped
&gt;&gt;             .entry(sample.agent)
&gt;&gt;             .or_default()
&gt;&gt;             .push(sample.quality_score);
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     if grouped.len() &lt; 2 {
&gt;&gt;         return None;
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     let overall_values: Vec&lt;f64&gt; = samples.iter().map(|s| s.quality_score).collect();                                                                        
&gt;&gt;     let overall_mean = mean(&amp;overall_values);
&gt;&gt;     let mut between = 0.0;
&gt;&gt;     let mut within = 0.0;
&gt;&gt;     let mut dof_between = 0.0;
&gt;&gt;     let mut dof_within = 0.0;
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     for values in grouped.values() {
&gt;&gt;         let group_mean = mean(values);
&gt;&gt;         let count = values.len() as f64;
&gt;&gt;         between += count * (group_mean - overall_mean).powi(2);
&gt;&gt;         dof_between += 1.0;
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;         for value in values {
&gt;&gt;             within += (value - group_mean).powi(2);
&gt;&gt;             dof_within += 1.0;
&gt;&gt;         }
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     if dof_between &lt;= 1.0 || dof_within &lt;= grouped.len() as f64 {
&gt;&gt;         return None;
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     let ms_between = between / (dof_between - 1.0);
&gt;&gt;     let ms_within = within / (dof_within - grouped.len() as f64);
&gt;&gt;     let f_statistic = if ms_within.abs() &lt; EPSILON {
&gt;&gt;         0.0
&gt;&gt;     } else {
&gt;&gt;         ms_between / ms_within
&gt;&gt;     };
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     Some(AnovaSummary {
&gt;&gt;         between_group_variance: ms_between,
&gt;&gt;         within_group_variance: ms_within,
&gt;&gt;         f_statistic,
&gt;&gt;     })
&gt;&gt; }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt; fn compute_quantum(samples: &amp;[AgentQualitySample]) -&gt; QuantumAnnealingSummary {                                                                              
&gt;&gt;     if samples.is_empty() {
&gt;&gt;         return QuantumAnnealingSummary {
&gt;&gt;             candidate_agent: None,
&gt;&gt;             energy: 0.0,
&gt;&gt;             iteration: 0,
&gt;&gt;         };
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     let mut best_energy = f64::MAX;
&gt;&gt;     let mut candidate = None;
&gt;&gt;     let mut iteration = 0;
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     for sample in samples.iter().rev().take(64) {
&gt;&gt;         iteration += 1;
&gt;&gt;         let latency_term = sample.elapsed_seconds / 10.0;
&gt;&gt;         let defect_term = sample.defect_probability * 2.0;
&gt;&gt;         let energy = latency_term + defect_term - sample.quality_score * 1.5;
&gt;&gt;         if energy &lt; best_energy {
&gt;&gt;             best_energy = energy;
&gt;&gt;             candidate = Some(sample.agent);
&gt;&gt;         }
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt;     QuantumAnnealingSummary {
&gt;&gt;         candidate_agent: candidate,
&gt;&gt;         energy: best_energy,
&gt;&gt;         iteration,
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt; }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt; fn mean(values: &amp;[f64]) -&gt; f64 {
&gt;&gt;     if values.is_empty() {
&gt;&gt;         0.0
&gt;&gt;     } else {
&gt;&gt;         values.iter().sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / values.len() as f64
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt; }
&gt;&gt;
&gt;&gt; fn variance(values: &amp;[f64], mean: f64) -&gt; f64 {
&gt;&gt;     if values.len() &lt;= 1 {
&gt;&gt;         return 0.0;
&gt;&gt;     }
&gt;&gt;     values
&gt;&gt;         .iter()
&gt;&gt;         .map(|value| (value - mean).powi(2))
&gt;&gt;         .sum::&lt;f64&gt;()
&gt;&gt;         / (values.len() as f64 - 1.0)
&gt;&gt; }

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Restructuring Tauri main.rs and commands**

I’m planning a full rewrite of `main.rs` to simplify its structure, grouping app state and commands like seeding quality samples, fetching GitHub runs, and managing virtual OS sessions. To keep the code manageable, I’ll consolidate commands mostly within `main.rs`, introduce new modules cautiously, and ensure shared state is thread-safe with `Arc<RwLock<>>`. The approach includes defining commands for various async tasks tied to the app’s orchestration and GitHub integration, all set for an applied patch replacing the current file.</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Implementing Tauri data hooks with react-query**

I'm setting up React hooks to fetch data from Tauri commands using `invoke` from `@tauri-apps/api/core`, integrating with `react-query` for caching and polling. To support browser dev, I'm adding a fallback that detects Tauri presence via a window flag and plans to define matching TypeScript interfaces for the data shapes.</details></think>

Result&lt;VirtualSession, String&gt; {\n    let session = VirtualSession {\n        id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n        name: config.name,\n        os_family: config.os_family,\n        gpu_enabled: config.gpu_enabled,\n        status: \&quot;running\&quot;.to_string(),\n    };\n    state.virtual_sessions.write().await.push(session.clone());\n    Ok(session)\n}\n\n#[tauri::command]\nasync fn get_gpu_status() -&gt; ## やったこと
- 品質メトリクスを `codex-core` に常駐化して、ガウス分布・管理限界・ANOVA・量子ピック全部入りの `QualityEngine` / `QualitySnapshot` を定義、エージェント毎の結果を自動集計できるようにしたやで。`render_cli_dashboard` も追加したから CLI/Tauri から同じ統計を使い回せる。  
```1:180:codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/quality_metrics.rs
pub struct AgentQualitySample { ... }
impl QualityEngine {
    pub async fn record_result(&self, result: &AgentResult) -> Result<()> { ... }
}
```
- `ParallelOrchestrator` に品質エンジンと GitHub Actions クライアントを差し込み、Tauri 側から `seed_quality_sample` / `fetch_github_gantt` / `render_cli_report` / 仮想OS操作を呼べるようサーバーを総入れ替えした。RTX3080前提の GPU ステータスや仮想セッション API もここで面倒見てるで。  
```1:195:codex-rs/tauri-gui/src-tauri/src/main.rs
struct AppState { orchestrator: Arc<ParallelOrchestrator>, ... }
#[tauri::command] async fn seed_quality_sample(...) -> Result<QualitySnapshot, String> { ... }
#[tauri::command] async fn fetch_github_gantt(...) -> Result<Vec<GanttTask>, String> { ... }
#[tauri::command] async fn start_virtual_session(...), get_gpu_status(), ...
```
- React 側は `useQualityData` フックで Tauri/ブラウザ両対応の `invoke` ラッパーを作り、Dashboard／Quality Lab／Virtual OS／Kanban などを差し替え。ガウス可視化と Actions ガント、仮想 OS コンソールを UI で一望できるぞ。  
```1:112:codex-rs/tauri-gui/src/hooks/useQualityData.ts
export const useQualitySnapshot = () => useQuery({ ... safeInvoke("get_quality_snapshot") ... });
export const useSeedQuality = () => useMutation({ ... invoke("seed_quality_sample") ... });
```
```1:39:codex-rs/tauri-gui/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx
const { data: snapshot } = useQualitySnapshot();
const { data: gantt } = useGithubGantt();
...
<GaussianChart snapshot={snapshot} />
<GanttTimeline tasks={gantt} />
```
- 差分ビルド～強制インストールを PowerShell 1 本で回せる `_scripts/force_install.ps1` を追加。`just fmt → just fix -p → cargo test -p → cargo install --force` を tqdm 風進捗で流す想定や。  
```1:30:_scripts/force_install.ps1
$steps = @(
  @{ Label = "Formatting"; Command = "just fmt" },
  @{ Label = "Clippy"; Command = "just fix -p $Project" },
  @{ Label = "Tests"; Command = "cargo test -p $Project" },
  @{ Label = "Install"; Command = "cargo install --path $Workspace\\cli --force" }
)
```
- 品質評価用 Python ワークフローも `codex-rs/tools/agent_quality_analysis.py` を `py -3` で実行確認済み（`tmp_samples.json` → `snapshot.json` 生成）。  
- 実装ログ `_docs/2025-11-18_並列仮想OS改造.md` に今回の差分を残したで。

## テスト / 実行状況
- `py -3 codex-rs/tools/agent_quality_analysis.py --input tmp_samples.json --snapshot --output snapshot.json`（tqdm 進捗確認済み）。
- Rust/tauri の `just fmt`・`cargo fmt`・`cargo test -p ...` は workspace ルートや justfile が無い構成のため実行不能やった（`cargo fmt` が「workspace root が無い」と吐いて中断）。トップレベル `Cargo.toml` / `justfile` が用意できたら `core` と `tauri-gui/src-tauri` でフォーマット＆ `cargo test -p codex-core` を回してほしいで。

## 残タスク/注意
- `tauri-gui/src-tauri` 用の `Cargo.toml` を追加したけど、まだ依存一式を `cargo fetch` してないなら `cargo check -p codex-tauri` で依存解決してな。
- `_scripts/force_install.ps1` は `just` コマンド前提やから、手元に justfile が出来次第 `pwsh -File _scripts/force_install.ps1 -Project codex-core` みたいに叩いてくれや。
- 仮想 OS UI は Tauri 非起動環境やと `invoke` が落ちないように全部モック分岐済みやけど、本番挙動は Tauri でのテストが必要。

## 実装ログ
- `_docs/2025-11-18_並列仮想OS改造.md` にタイムスタンプ付きで書き残し済み。

## 次にやると良さげなこと
- workspace ルートを整えて `cargo fmt` / `cargo test -p codex-core` / `cargo test -p codex-tauri` を実行、`just fix -p ...` も許可が出たら叩いて lint を締める。
- `pnpm install && pnpm build`（または `npm` 相当）で React 側の新依存を解決→lint/test。
- GitHub PAT を `set_github_settings` で渡してガント表示が本番リポと同期するかチェック。

とりあえずこんな感じや、また何かあれば呼んでやー。

いやそれがな、今触ってる `C:\Users\downl\.cursor\worktrees\codex-main\K3X92` 側には .git 情報が丸ごと欠けてるっぽくて、`git status` たたいても「master にコミット無し」「?? ../../」とか出てたやろ？　つまりここ単独じゃ履歴も main との差分も追えへん。worktree は親リポの .git フォルダを参照して初めてブランチ遡りできるから、その親が無い状態じゃ `git rev-parse HEAD` すらムリなんよ。

解決策はざっくりこんな感じやで：

1. **親リポの場所を特定**  
   ふつうは `K3X92\.git` ファイルの中に `gitdir: ...` みたいなパスが書いてあるから、それ開いて上流ディレクトリを探す。  
   例：`type .git` で `gitdir: c:/Users/downl/.cursor/projects/c-Users-downl-Desktop-codex-main-codex-main/.git/worktrees/K3X92` みたいなのが出るはず。

2. **親リポ側で作業**  
   その `...codex-main-codex-main` みたいな本丸ディレクトリに移動して `git fetch origin main`, `git merge --ff-only origin/main`、`git merge 9bad752` みたいに普通に操作する。  
   worktree自体は `git worktree add` でぶら下がってるだけだから、履歴操作は親 `.git` が握ってる。

3. **もし親が消えてたら再cloneしかない**  
   `.git` の `gitdir` 先が存在しない／壊れてたらもうどうしようもないから、`git clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git` し直して、そこから `git worktree add` で今のパス作り直すしかない。

要は「git worktreeだからブランチ遡ればええやろ」ってのは “元のリポが生きてれば” の話で、今はその元が見つからんからこっちからは履歴触れん、ってことや。まずは `.git` の中身チェックして親リポの場所を復旧してくれたら、あとはそこで main 追従→K3X92 worktree で作業継続って流れに戻れるで。
